description: Test suite for the CallbackVisitor class in the HTTP/2 adapter, verifying handling of various HTTP/2 frames and stream events.

classes.name: CallbackVisitor
classes.description: A class that visits HTTP/2 frames and stream events, used for testing and validation.

methods.name: OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Handles the beginning of a frame, dispatching based on frame type and stream ID.

methods.name: OnSettingsStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a SETTINGS frame.

methods.name: OnSettingsEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a SETTINGS frame.

methods.name: stream_map_size
methods.description: Returns the current number of streams being tracked.

methods.name: set_stream_close_listener
methods.description: Sets a callback for when streams are closed.

methods.name: OnBeginHeadersForStream
methods.description: Handles the start of headers for a stream.

methods.name: OnHeaderForStream
methods.description: Handles a header field for a stream.

methods.name: OnEndHeadersForStream
methods.description: Handles the end of headers for a stream.

methods.name: OnBeginDataForStream
methods.description: Handles the start of data for a stream.

methods.name: OnDataForStream
methods.description: Handles data chunk received for a stream.

methods.name: OnEndStream
methods.description: Handles the end of a stream.
